answer: Run admission as a sealed auction at each inlet: agents bid POA for 100 slots; top bids win and winning bids are burned. A lone agent pays once; a Sybil farmer wanting 50 fake identities must outbid honest agents 50 times, spending 50x200 POA = 10,000 POA, while each fake earns at most 30 POA over a horizon of 20 epochs, so it loses money. Honest agents pay once and keep a saffron badge marking paid entry, so rewards are never diluted by clones.
